items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know Harrison Barnes has a little book that he kept all the dates in... [INTERVIEWEE] No, I don't have. When he played with Chris Kelly. No, I don't have that.

ctx.x: No, no, just get the job, you know, by him going to school, you see. You know, used to go to different schools, you see. So, but I never had no manager, no real manager, you know, like some band. But if I had a manager, you know what I mean, we would. Did you ever keep a little book?

I know Harrison Barnes has a little book that he kept all the dates in to tell just when they were playing how much money they got for each date and everything. No, I don't have. When he played with Chris Kelly. No, I don't have that. You never did keep it?

I don't have. I might have some old, I bet I got some old contract home. Some old one, you know, way back. I bet I got still got some. You see some of those real old contracts. Yeah, I got some old one there in a box. And so I tell you, well, we didn't never had no, no, no, no body to, you know what I mean, but we managed our own self, you see. Well, in fact, we didn't need nobody because we getting more, you know what I mean? We getting more jobs. We could do our own self, you know what I mean? And so that lady…
